About This Figure → Source and Calculation

NMBA programme page, proposed dashboard, 1440px. 6 Oct 2026.

Tiles on a programme page — demo-rail switch OFF

Before: every tile is a button and the chart carries an ⓘ, for every reader. After: plain figures, no ⓘ — nothing about sources unless the switch is on.

Clicking a figure — switch OFF

Before: About This Figure opens for any reader, showing Programme, Shown To, Theme, Figures For and a Data Feed badge. After: nothing opens; the tile is a figure, not a control.

Tiles — switch ON

After: each tile and chart gets the same ⓘ the rest of the dashboard uses.

The panel — switch ON

Before: About This Figure. After: one Source and Calculation panel — source type, where it was read from, date, API link, Updated, Figures For, formula, and the working.
